heading: Single-Agent Execution
detail_pairs: What It Is
Runs a single agent for a focused job — described once through the builder, ready to run. Set up once through the builder — role, tools, and knowledge scope — then reusable for every future run.
Why It Matters

A focused job doesn't need a custom orchestration script written for it — the builder handles setup once. Every agent is owned and organization-scoped the moment it's created, so nothing runs unaccountably.
How It Works

OneChat's runtime supports single-agent execution and multi-agent team orchestration from the same builder. Backed by Django-persisted agent records, so configuration survives beyond a single session.
Where This Lives in the Platform
Live in production Runs on OneChat's existing agent runtime today, not a planned feature.
